description: This file defines the MenuTreeStorage class in Drupal, responsible for managing menu tree data stored in a database. It includes methods for loading, saving, rebuilding, and deleting menu links, as well as handling hierarchical relationships and caching.

classes.name: MenuTreeStorage
classes.description: Provides a database-backed storage for menu trees, supporting operations like load, save, delete, rebuild, and cache management for menu links in Drupal.

methods.name: maxDepth
methods.description: Returns the maximum depth of the menu tree hierarchy, defined as a class constant.

methods.name: resetDefinitions
methods.description: Clears the cached plugin definitions to force reload.

methods.name: rebuild
methods.description: Rebuilds the menu tree from provided definitions, handling hierarchy, orphan links, and cache invalidation.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a menu link and invalidates related cache tags.

methods.name: saveRecursive
methods.description: Recursively saves a menu link and its children, maintaining hierarchy.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a menu link by ID, reattaching children to the parent, and updates cache tags.

methods.name: getSubtreeHeight
methods.description: Calculates the height of a subtree starting from a given link ID.

methods.name: loadByProperties
methods.description: Loads menu links matching specific property conditions.

methods.name: loadByRoute
methods.description: Loads menu links associated with a specific route name and parameters.

methods.name: loadMultiple
methods.description: Loads multiple menu links by their IDs, utilizing internal cache.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a single menu link by ID, using internal cache if available.

methods.name: loadFull
methods.description: Loads all database fields for a menu link by ID.

methods.name: loadFullMultiple
methods.description: Loads all database fields for multiple menu links by IDs.

methods.name: getRootPathIds
methods.description: Retrieves the root path IDs for a given menu link ID.

methods.name: getExpanded
methods.description: Finds all expanded menu links starting from given parent IDs.

methods.name: loadTreeData
methods.description: Loads and caches the menu tree data for a given menu and parameters.

methods.name: loadLinks
methods.description: Loads menu links based on parameters, with support for custom roots and conditions.

methods.name: collectRoutesAndDefinitions
methods.description: Collects unique route names and definitions from a menu tree.

methods.name: doCollectRoutesAndDefinitions
methods.description: Recursively collects route names and definitions from a menu tree.

methods.name: loadSubtreeData
methods.description: Loads a subtree of the menu starting from a specific link ID.

methods.name: menuNameInUse
methods.description: Checks if a menu name is already in use.

methods.name: getMenuNames
methods.description: Retrieves all distinct menu names.

methods.name: countMenuLinks
methods.description: Counts the number of links in a menu, optionally filtered by menu name.

methods.name: getAllChildIds
methods.description: Retrieves all child link IDs under a specific link.

methods.name: loadAllChildren
methods.description: Loads all descendant links of a specific link ID.

methods.name: doBuildTreeData
methods.description: Prepares data for building a menu tree structure.

methods.name: treeDataRecursive
methods.description: Recursively builds a nested array representing the menu tree.

methods.name: ensureTableExists
methods.description: Checks if the menu tree table exists and creates it if not.

methods.name: serializedFields
methods.description: Determines which database fields are serialized.

methods.name: definitionFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields that are part of the plugin definition.

methods.name: schemaDefinition
methods.description: Defines the database schema for the menu tree table.

methods.name: findNoLongerExistingLinks
methods.description: Finds links that were previously discovered but no longer exist in the new definitions.

methods.name: doDeleteMultiple
methods.description: Deletes multiple menu links by their IDs.

methods.name: setParents
methods.description: Sets materialized path fields based on parent link.

methods.name: moveChildren
methods.description: Re-parents children links when a parent link is moved.

methods.name: findParent
methods.description: Finds the parent link definition for a given link.

methods.name: updateParentalStatus
methods.description: Updates the has_children flag for a parent link.

methods.name: prepareLink
methods.description: Unserializes fields and prepares a link for storage.
